item.title: Credit Bureaus Were Open Banking Before APIs
item.author: info@januszczak.org (John Januszczak)
item.description: Credit bureaus show that open banking is not a new idea. It is the latest version of a much older bargain: share trusted financial data, reduce risk, and widen access to credit.

item.title: Finscore
item.author: info@januszczak.org (John Januszczak)
item.description: The Philippines’ leading alternative credit scoring provider that utilizes telco and social data to determine creditworthiness for the unbanked, recently acquired by Malaysia’s CTOS Digital
